prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: portrait hero illustration for Karmanya Ayurveda's knee-pain consultation landing page, used beside a headline, 4:5 vertical composition. Create an elegant editorial illustration of a relatable Indian woman about 55 years old, in a simple muted coral kurta and slate-blue trousers, seated upright on a stable light-wood chair in a minimal warm ivory home. Her feet are planted naturally on the floor and one hand gently rests on her knee; calm thoughtful expression, slight everyday discomfort, dignified and approachable. Full seated figure clearly visible with generous breathing room around head, hands and feet. Hand-painted soft gouache texture, refined natural proportions, subtle dimensional shading, restrained coral, amber, slate-blue and cream palette; no dominant green. Very simple pale ivory backdrop with one soft curved amber shape, no detailed room, no hard frame. Looks clearly illustrated, not a photograph. No pain glow, no arrows, no anatomy overlays, no labels or text, no logos, no watermark, no doctor, no clinic, no before/after or promised outcome.
